diagnosis: All four rollouts passed without providing any of the decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4). This indicates that the model is defaulting to common practices and thresholds that do not require the hidden information. For example, the max_concurrent_connections is set to 10,000, which matches the draft and does not require the change specified in PF2. Similarly, the client_retry_interval_seconds is set to 5 seconds, matching the draft and not requiring the change in PF1.

fix_instructions: Tighten the checks C2 and C7 to require specific values that deviate from common defaults. Specifically, update check C2 to require the max_concurrent_connections to be exactly 6,000, as specified in PF2. Update check C7 to require the client_retry_interval_seconds to be exactly 30 seconds, as specified in PF1.
